The auto sector has been one of the hardest-hit in Europe this year, as intense competition from cheaper Chinese rivals, surging energy prices and volatility from U.S. President Donald Trump's tariff agenda have battered the sector.
Volkswagen, Europe's largest automaker, has been engulfed in a crisis that intensified on Friday after it flagged a €10 billion ($11.5 billion) profit warning, mostly at its Porsche
An index of European auto stocks has fallen around 16% this year (.SXAP), ranking it among the worst-performing after consumer products (.SXCDP).
STOXX, the index provider, announced the decision on September 1 as part of its annual review of leavers and joiners.
